title: Professional Certificate Course in Public Health Regulations Ethics and Policies
description: In this course, the learners will learn public health regulations, ethics, and policies to advance their careers and positively impact the health of their community.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Public Health Regulations Ethics and Policies covers key topics such as public health regulations, reforms, federal budget process, health programs, ethics, accreditation board, performance management, standards, and areas of practice for public health specialists. By the end of this course, you will have a comprehensive understanding of the policies and regulations that govern public health and be equipped to effectively navigate the complex landscape of public health regulations and ethics. You will also gain practical skills in performance management and learn about the standards and areas of practice that are essential for successful public health practice.
